summary: [standards] An interrupted review re-pin cannot be resumed (read from the code, not run). If the run stops after tier.write_unarchived wrote the new version but before remove_file(from), the next plan finds the same old-pin review at from and apply takes the old_file.is_file() branch again; plan_write refuses with DuplicatePath because to exists, so every rerun is MIGRATE_STOPPED although the message says rerunning finishes it. Fix: when to already holds the expected bytes, skip the write and go on to archive and remove.
